sloka: नृशंस इति मां कामं वक्ष्यन्ति मनुजा भुवि ।श्रुत्वा तस्यागुणान् सर्वे वक्ष्यन्ति सुकृतं पुनः ।। ६.११४.९६ ।।
transliteration: nṛśaṁsa iti māṁ kāmaṁ vakṣyanti manujā bhuvi ।śrutvā tasyāguṇān sarve vakṣyanti sukṛtaṁ punaḥ ।। 6.114.96 ।।

translations.english: "This Ravana remained doing harm to all and does not deserve the respect of his elder brother, or prayers. He is an enemy in the form of brother. He does not deserve to be worshipped.
